restoration_note: The teaching describes the natural mind built as nested circuits: the Five Powers of Darkness (the self) hung within the Five Sons of First Man (rational from Divine Human), then within the Five Sons of Living Spirit (rational ascending), all beneath the firmament where the King of Honor governs the cosmos. Editor restorations at line breaks and at standard cosmological titles (Living Spirit, King of Honor, firmament) are confirmed by the spiritual reading. The middle section (gaps 6-14, 17-19) suffered substantial damage — only short partials remain, with multiple unknown words per line — and cannot be recovered without invention. The structural arc is intact even where vocabulary is lost.
